visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with black hair and a tan coat speaks to a handheld camera inside a brightly lit airport terminal. In the background, other travelers walk through the spacious hall under a high, arched wooden ceiling. (2) Close-up shot of an airport departure screen displaying 'VIENA' and 'IBE 0793'. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) The woman is now on a shuttle bus or plane, showing her small blue bag. She gestures towards the window. (4) Inside the airplane cabin, a flight attendant demonstrates safety procedures. A shot follows showing generous legroom in an exit row seat. (5) View from an airplane window showing a white wing over a vast landscape of clouds and snow-capped mountain peaks under a clear blue sky. (6) On the plane, the woman uses her hands to knit a multi-colored wool sock with thin needles. She looks out the window occasionally. (7) Arrival at another airport terminal; the woman pushes a luggage cart. In the background, a child in a white shirt and other travelers are visible near vending machines. (8) A black van is parked outside. The trunk is opened to reveal a massive pile of diverse suitcases packed tightly. A man in sunglasses smiles while standing by the vehicle. (9) The woman is sitting inside the van, speaking and smiling. The sun shines brightly through the window, creating high contrast. (10) POV shot from a moving vehicle passing a large, ornate Gothic cathedral with twin spires under a clear sky. (11) A wide view from a high rooftop terrace overlooking a city at sunset. The sky is a gradient of orange, pink, and blue. (12) Interior tour of an apartment: showing a living room with a blue sofa, a dining area with modern lights, and finally an attic bedroom with a sloped ceiling, a desk with a laptop, and a bed featuring a small brown teddy bear.
